'''Rancor's Maze''' was an [[Arcade game/Legends|arcade game]] that could be played in the [[Raging Rancor Cantina]] in [[Varna Biqua]], on [[Genarius]]. Players would have to move their holo-projection to safety, before a [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] found and ate them.
